note: Canonical-level facts per ISO 639-3 code (batch 1). Joined by tools/build-inventory.py onto relationship records. tts/translation: true(confident yes) / false(confident no) / null(unknown→review) / na(sign language, not applicable). glottocode: null everywhere in pass 1 — never guessed (Phase 3 allows null).

abk.notes: 639-1 ab (SIL). De-facto official (Abkhazia constitution); Cyrillic official, Mkhedruli historic.

acm.notes: MSA (ar) tools do not cover Mesopotamian dialect

acq.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. South Yemen; war-soft figures.

acw.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Hejaz; pilgrim-city contact effects.

acx.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Most conservative Gulf variety (interdentals kept). Distinct from Shihhi.

ady.notes: Adyghe/Circassian. Canonical Latn (bigger TR-diaspora community); RU homeland uses Cyrillic (override later). Pre-verification caught adh=Adhola trap.

aen.notes: Armenian SL; Yerevan network, post-Soviet standardisation.

afb.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Gulf koine (AE/SA-East/QA/KW/BH); Kuwaiti drama-dialect famous.

afg.notes: Verification pass 2: code afg confirmed (SIL: Afghan Sign Language; Ethnologue notes Jalalabad variety). Kabul-variety relationship still needs deaf-org sources.

amh.notes: 639-1 am (SIL). IL Ethiopian-Jewish community; ET homeland in future batch.

apc.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. ajp (South Levantine) retired 2023-01-20 → merged here; JO/Palestinian/Syrian/LB/IL all apc.

arb.notes: iso639_1 'ar' is the Arabic macrolanguage; MSA coverage SIL bulk 2026-09-14: no Part1 on this code; 639-1 belongs to macro 'ara'.

ars.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Riyadh-media prestige; E. Syria/SW Iraq spillover.

ayh.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Hadramawt + sleeper diaspora (SE Asia/E. Africa heritage demand).

ayn.notes: MSA (arb) tools do not cover this variety. Highland Yemen; qaf-shibboleth famous; war-soft figures.

azb.notes: Google 'az' covers North/Latin only; South/Perso-Arabic not separately

azj.notes: NORTH Azerbaijani — engines serve this standard (unlike South azb: false/false). Split class pan/pnb.

bft.notes: Tibetic language in Perso-Arabic script — rare combination

bho.notes: Kaithi heritage script; Devanagari in practice

brh.notes: Dravidian outlier in Balochistan; Latin orthography also used

bsk.notes: Unrelated to any known family; Latin orthography also used

ckb.notes: Google Translate Sorani present (medium); TTS unknown

diq.notes: SIL 'Dimli (individual language)'; Zaza macro (zza) member with kiu. Diyarbakır-side. Native verify (Jacobson Latin).

dng.notes: World's only Cyrillic Sinitic; Hui-Muslim ancestry. KZ+KG cross-border planning unit (~130k).

doi.notes: Takri heritage script; Devanagari official SIL bulk 2026-09-14: scope=M (Dogri macro: dgo individual + xnr Kangri).

dyl.notes: Batch-3 sign hunt: code dyl confirmed (was mis/disputed in batch 1).

fas.notes: Macro: Western Persian pes is the Iran standard; prs/tgk mutually intelligible standards SIL bulk 2026-09-14: Tajik (tgk) is Persian linguistically but NOT a fas member per SIL (standalone code) — removed.

fil.notes: PH official (Tagalog-based); Gulf L1≈community clean case. 639-1 'tl' belongs to tgl — fil carries none.

fra.notes: 639-1 fr (SIL). LB Art.11 footnote + francophonie; world language, EkGuru Hindi-first.

heb.notes: 639-1 he (SIL). Only fully successful revival on Earth; IL state language (2018 law).

hye.notes: Covers Eastern standard here; Western Armenian (hyw) separate individual SIL bulk 2026-09-14: scope=I individual (Eastern Armenian); Western Armenian is hyw — macro claim withdrawn.

isr.notes: Israeli SL; village signs sqx/syy are separately coded — do not merge.

jos.notes: Jordanian SL; pre-verification caught jor=Jorá trap.

kaa.notes: SIL Ref_Name 'Kara-Kalpak'. Official in Karakalpakstan; Latin (1995) + Cyrillic legacy. Closest relative Kazakh, not Uzbek.

kas.notes: Perso-Arabic + Devanagari both notified in J&K

kat.notes: 639-1 ka (SIL). Mkhedruli script (one of ~14 world scripts); GE state language.

kaz.notes: State language KZ (+ UZ minority). Cyrillic now; KZ Latin-transition roadmap underway; Perso-Arabic in CN — multi-script note.

kiu.notes: SIL 'Kirmanjki (individual language)'; zza member. Tunceli/Dersim-side, Alevi-majority. Native verify.

kmr.notes: Latin-script tradition (Perso-Arabic also used); TTS unknown

kmz.notes: Endonym usually just 'Turki'; code treatment verify pass 2

kok.notes: Five-script tradition; Devanagari mandated in Goa SIL bulk 2026-09-14: members gom + knn (Konkani individual).

lez.notes: SIL spells 'Lezghian'. AZ highlands + bigger RU-Dagestan side (future batch).

luz.notes: Includes Bakhtiari per Ethnologue treatment — pass-2 check

mby.notes: Gujarati + Perso-Arabic both used; endonym spelling verify

mgp.notes: NP entry (verification pass 2: absorbed retired mrd 2026-07-15). Devanagari rendering per NP census; autonym nuance verify.

mni.notes: Macro treatment + Meitei Mayek (Mtei) revival; family subgroup verify pass 2; Google Translate Meitei presence uncertain SIL bulk 2026-09-14: scope=I individual — macro claim withdrawn.

nep.notes: Macro wrapper; sole living member npi (Nepal entry) — same language, dual-code treatment documented SIL bulk 2026-09-14: members dty (Dotyali) + npi.

npi.notes: Individual code; India's scheduled entry uses macro 'nep' — same language SIL bulk 2026-09-14: no Part1 on this code; 639-1 belongs to macro 'nep'.

ory.notes: SIL bulk 2026-09-14: no Part1 on this code; 639-1 belongs to macro 'ori'.

pan.notes: Eastern Punjabi (Gurmukhi); Western/Shahmukhi is pnb — distinct

pbu.notes: Google 'ps' collective covers Pashto; per-variety TTS unknown

pnb.notes: Western Panjabi (Shahmukhi); Google 'pa' is Eastern/Gurmukhi only

prs.notes: Translation via Persian (fa); Dari-specific TTS unknown

rhg.notes: Hanifi Rohingya script (Rohg, Unicode); Arabic + Latin also used

rjs.notes: Devanagari in NP; Bengali script across border; Kamtapuri continuum dispute

rus.notes: 639-1 ru (SIL). Official KZ/KG; interethnic TJ/UZ; lapsed TM. EkGuru teaches Hindi TO Russian speakers — never a Russian course.

san.notes: Liturgical/scholarly; census L1 is symbolic self-report SIL bulk 2026-09-14: scope=M (cls Classical + vsn Vedic), type=H Historical — living liturgical/official use noted, registry type stands.

sat.notes: Google Translate added Santali (Ol Chiki) 2024 — medium confidence; TTS absent

sgh.notes: No standard orthography (Tajik-Cyrillic ad hoc + scholarly Latin); native null honestly. State broadcast recognition (Khorog).

sin.notes: Diglossic — course must teach spoken first

snd.notes: Perso-Arabic (52 letters) + Devanagari in India; TTS unknown

tat.notes: Kazan/Mishar mix in CA. Distinct from Crimean Tatar (crh).

tgk.notes: 639-1 tg (SIL). Persian linguistically but NOT a fas member per SIL (standalone). Internal LF TJ + UZ Samarkand/Bukhara.

tly.notes: Latin/Cyrillic used across border in Azerbaijan republic

tsj.notes: Primarily oral; Tibetan script where written

tsm.notes: Turkish SL (TİD); village sign Mardin (dsz) is separate.

tuk.notes: Perso-Arabic in IR/AF; Latin in Turkmenistan

tur.notes: CA entries are mostly Meskhetian-deportee communities (Istanbul standard in school, dialect at home).

uig.notes: SIL Ref_Name 'Uighur' (old spelling). Soviet-Cyrillic legacy, now Perso-Arabic; exile-Latin exists — script choice political.

uzn.notes: NORTHERN Uzbek (Uzbekistan/CA standard); Latin official (UZ 1993 law), Cyrillic legacy (TJ/KG/UZ print). SIL identity audit 2026-09-14: corrected ex-Southern misfile (AF side is now uzs).

uzs.notes: SOUTHERN Uzbek (Afghanistan, Perso-Arabic). Split from uzn in 2026-09-14 identity audit; native Perso-Arabic form verify.

ved.notes: Affiliation disputed (isolate vs Indo-Aryan); moribund, primarily oral — do not assign family/script without source SIL bulk 2026-09-14: confirmed ved = Veddah (scope I, living).

xct.notes: Chöke — monastic register, not modern spoken Tibetan (bod) SIL bulk 2026-09-14: type=H Historical (Classical Tibetan) — status HISTORICAL.

xmf.notes: DISPUTED: GE state = dialect of Georgian; ISO/Ethnologue = language. Rule 12: follow Ethnologue + disputed flag.

yai.notes: SIL spells 'Yagnobi'. Primarily oral; Vedda-class threshold exception.

ydd.notes: EASTERN Yiddish (IL Haredi L1, growing). Macro yid = ydd + yih; Western (yih) is EXTINCT per SIL.
